text:
marcos: kicking off kubeadm bootstrap for ap-east-edge-1. target: 3 GPU nodepools (mixed spot+on-demand), MTU=9000 originally but we may need to override, cilium CNI, nvidia driver via DaemonSet. need quick sanity checklist + who owns autoscaler and nodepool sizing?
anya: I can take autoscaler + nodepool sizing. suggestion: 2 on-demand A10g, 6 spot T4s for baseline, spot fallback to on-demand. I'll push TF changes for mixed instances and taints.
sarah: note ap-east has ENI/secondary-ip limits — avoid tiny instance types unless we enable trunking. this affects pod density on GPU nodes.
kai: also flag: our corporate VPN enforces 1500 MTU across peering. unless we control entire path keep overlay MTU at 1500 to avoid fragmentation.
devon: driver plan: nvidia-driver via privileged DaemonSet that installs RPMs, plus nvidia-device-plugin and node-feature-discovery to label GPU SKUs. use internal registry for images.
marcos: adding a short checklist: 1) kubeadm init --config=bootstrap-ap-east.yaml 2) apply cilium CRDs + cilium helm values (tunnel: vxlan, mtu override) 3) join workers 4) apply nvidia DaemonSet + device-plugin 5) enable cluster-autoscaler with mixed instances 6) smoke tests
liza: I'll run preflight and smoke. quick smoke cmds: ```kubectl get nodes -o wide; kubectl get pods -n kube-system --field-selector=status.phase!=Running; kubectl describe node <node> | grep -i kubelet``` I will paste outputs here.
infra-bot: cluster-bootstrap event: started by marcos (bootstrap-id=brst-2143658700)
liza: preflight update: control-plane failed kubeadm preflight due to missing conntrack. fix: install conntrack package in control-plane image or run apt-get conntrack before init.
anya: conntrack installed on control-plane, re-ran init. also pushed tf update with mixedInstancePolicy + autoscaler min=3 desired=5 max=12.
sarah: observed kubelet errors on a GPU node referencing hugepages config. quick fix: ensure systemd config doesn't set hugepages unless requested; or set kubelet feature gates accordingly.
kai: for spot resilience add aws-node-termination-handler DaemonSet and use cluster-autoscaler flag --balance-similar-node-groups; add proper tolerations for termination taints.
marcos: handoff: @anya owns autoscaler TF and rollout, @liza will validate smoke + GPU device-plugin, @kai will lock MTU to 1500 in docs and networking helm values, @devon will verify driver install logs. leaving notes in runbooks/ap-east-edge-resilience.md :thumbsup:
devon: once all green, we'll route a small canary to dedicated GPU pool and monitor latency + GPU sched failures. set alert for OOMKilled and GPU plugin crashloop.
